description: Exploit; this is E011's contingency. Progressive resizing on the Muon incumbent, with more total epochs. Use 10.5 epochs in total. Train the first 50% of epochs on whole augmented images downscaled to 24 px on the GPU (bilinear F.interpolate; AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) as in E011) and the rest at 32 px. Define the LR schedule over total steps. Compile with dynamic=False and warm up both shapes in build, so nothing recompiles in the timed region. Keep everything else at E007.
